The AgentTeams worker image: a cachyos base composing the
agentteams-worker layer — the openclaw gateway runtime (built from
the pinned upstream source commit) with the agt REST client, mc, and
the shared AgentTeams protocol libs. The controller spawns this image
for Worker CRs through the host rootless podman socket; the worker
joins the charly network and reaches the controller's in-container
services by the controller container's DNS name. Rootless: the
service runs as the image user (uid 1000).

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-supervisord:v2026.271.1817`
- `@github.com/opencharly/pod-agentteams-worker:v2026.274.0808`
